baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated group هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ, the nested phrases فِى ظِلَٰلٍ and عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ, and the predicate مُتَّكِـُٔونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Pairing supplies a relational unit, shade places that unit inside shelter, couches furnish a stable support, and reclining makes the support bodily received. The plural scene is therefore organized companionship rather than a list of isolated luxuries.

activation_trace.role: A counterpart joined to its mate supplies the relational unit that enters repose.
Covering shade supplies the enclosing shelter around the paired group.
The furnished couch in an enclosed chamber supplies the concrete place of repose.
Leaning on a support converts the setting into bodily ease and received support.

changed_reading.before: People, spouses, shade, couches, and reclining form a static inventory of paradise comforts.
changed_reading.after: A relationally paired group is spatially nested in shelter and bodily settled into received support.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of paired companions, protective shade, abiding place, and supported posture across أَزْوَٰجُهُمْ, ظِلَٰلٍ, ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ, and مُتَّكِـُٔونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Several focus branches converge on remaining held: companions cohere by a shared condition, shade functions as protective custody, the couch root contributes staying in a place, and the reclining root can carry fullness and retention. Repose becomes durable settlement rather than a pause between movements.

activation_trace.role: Companions joined by likeness or shared action supply social coherence beyond mere proximity.
Shade as protection and guarded ease turns enclosure into security.
Remaining in a place supplies permanence beneath the surface image of a couch.
Fullness and retention supply the image of abundance held without leakage or dispersal.

changed_reading.before: The ayah depicts a pleasant but temporary pause.
changed_reading.after: The ayah depicts a guarded settlement in which fitted companions remain together, the place is not left, and fullness is securely retained.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier bodies are held by collars with heads forced upward, and an imposed covering blocks sight; forgiveness then introduces a covering that preserves rather than disables. The focus shade and reclining support reverse both the ethics and the bodily geometry of enclosure: cover protects, and support permits voluntary ease.

activation_trace.role: A collar that binds an organ supplies coercive bodily holding as the negative pole.
The raised head unable to lower toward water supplies forced posture rather than ease.
A covering laid over something supplies enclosure whose effect is occlusion.
Covering the fault while protecting its bearer supplies the preserving alternative to blinding cover.
Protective shade converts enclosure into guarded ease.
Voluntary reliance on support reverses the earlier rigid and imposed posture.

structural_cues: The sequence 36:8-11 distinguishes bodily binding, sight-blocking cover, and preserving forgiveness before 36:56 combines shelter with relaxed support.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies harmful holding, harmful covering, and preserving covering; I infer an ethical and bodily reversal in the focus scene. Alternatively, the images may contrast punishment and reward only at a general level.

changed_reading.before: Shade and reclining indicate generic protection and comfort.
changed_reading.after: Cover and bodily support have been transformed from forced rigidity and blindness into voluntary ease under preserving shelter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The city witness crosses distance in purposeful motion, is told to enter the tree-screened garden, and names forgiveness and honor. His trajectory supplies an embodied route from strenuous public movement to the focus ayah's abiding, supported repose.

activation_trace.role: The farthest side supplies the distance from which the witness's movement begins.
Purposeful movement toward a sought end supplies effort and direction.
Entry into an interior supplies the threshold from motion to dwelling.
A garden screened by trees supplies the sheltered destination.
Protective covering of fault supplies the transition into safety.
Bestowed honor supplies the social dignity of the destination.
Abiding in place turns the witness's arrival into settled residence.
Supported reclining supplies rest after purposeful exertion.

structural_cues: 36:20-27 forms a compact movement, entry, forgiveness, and honor sequence that can orient the later garden tableau.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a witness who moves from the city's far side into forgiven and honored garden entry; I read the focus repose as a possible endpoint of that trajectory. Alternatively, the witness is an exemplar of the destination without defining every occupant in 36:56.

changed_reading.before: The reclining figures are anonymous occupants already at leisure.
changed_reading.after: Their repose can be read as honored arrival after costly purposeful movement, with effort resolved rather than forgotten.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first places all pairs within a created field that includes earth-growth, selves, and unknown kinds. When the same root appears in the focus, marital spouses remain the nearest reading, but pair can also carry fitted counterparts, kinds, and companions whose relation belongs to the wider order of creation.

activation_trace.role: Pairs as kinds or classes widen the repeated root beyond an exclusively marital scope.
Growth emerging from earth supplies the ecological domain in which pairing operates.
Living, productive earth grounds the paired order materially.
The self or very identity of a thing brings human pairings inside the same created pattern.
The spouse branch preserves the direct domestic reading in the focus.
A joined counterpart lets the domestic pair participate in the surah's broader relational order.

structural_cues: The exact focus root recurs at 36:36 inside an exhaustive sequence: earth-growth, selves, and what remains unknown.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit universal pairing statement and repeats its root in the focus; I infer that the local spouse sense is nested within that larger order. Alternatively, syntax may keep أَزْوَٰجُهُمْ narrowly marital despite the earlier widening.

changed_reading.before: أَزْوَٰجُهُمْ means only the marital spouses accompanying individuals.
changed_reading.after: The marital reading remains live, while the group also embodies creation's fitted pairs and kinds: companions joined by complementarity, likeness, or shared condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Descendants are borne in a filled vessel, people ride created conveyances, drowning remains possible, and rescue is attributed to mercy. The focus reclining root contributes both reliance on a support and, more distantly, tying a vessel; the couch can therefore be read as a safely bearing support rather than a badge of self-sufficiency.

activation_trace.role: Bearing a visible load supplies the basic relation between occupants and support.
The vessel moving in water supplies a support that carries bodies through danger.
Filling the vessel supplies held fullness rather than emptiness.
Riding on the back of a conveyance makes bodily dependence on support explicit.
Drowning supplies the failed-support alternative that makes safe bearing consequential.
Extraction from danger supplies rescue rather than autonomous survival.
Merciful tenderness supplies the stated cause of continued safe carriage.
Tying a vessel supplies a material image of contents securely held.
Leaning on support transfers the carried relation from transport to repose.

structural_cues: 36:41-44 repeatedly places human continuity on a bearer and makes rescue contingent; 36:56 again depicts bodies giving weight to a support.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies carrying, riding, failed carriage, rescue, and mercy; I transfer that support relation analogically from vessel to couch. Alternatively, the transport episode may only establish divine power and temporary preservation, not the material logic of the later furniture.

changed_reading.before: The couch is a self-contained luxury possessed by its reclining occupant.
changed_reading.after: The couch is a safely bearing support: repose acknowledges carried dependence, secure holding, and mercy after the possibility of failed support.

context_deltas.mechanism: The trumpet produces rapid emergence, the sleepers are stirred from their resting place, all are gathered and brought present, and action is recompensed. Reclining then follows as conscious stability after acceleration and adjudication, not as another form of deathlike sleep.

activation_trace.role: Rapid forward movement supplies the kinetic onset of resurrection.
Stirring what was still supplies awakening and renewed agency.
Sleep and stillness supply the former resting state from which they are awakened.
Joining what was dispersed supplies collective recomposition.
Presence and nearness supply accountable wakefulness before the focus scene.
Action met by its recompense supplies the completed adjudication that precedes repose.
Abiding in place supplies a new stable endpoint after the rush and gathering.
Supported reclining supplies wakeful ease rather than the former sleep of the resting place.

structural_cues: 36:51-56 moves through rushing, awakening, gathering, presence, recompense, delight, and finally reclining.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a tightly ordered change of bodily states; I infer that the second stillness in 36:56 is qualitatively transformed by the intervening awakening and judgment. Alternatively, reclining may simply be one reward image without deliberate contrast to مَرْقَدِنَا.

changed_reading.before: Reclining resembles passive or sleepy leisure.
changed_reading.after: Reclining is wakeful post-resurrection rest: accelerated bodies have arrived, been made present, and can now remain without compulsion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate frame calls the garden inhabitants occupied rather than vacant, marks their inward delight, gives them what they call for, and places a merciful word of peace over the scene. Bodily stillness therefore coexists with active enjoyment, relational availability, request, and receptive hearing.

activation_trace.role: Occupation as the opposite of vacancy blocks a reading of reclining as empty idleness.
Delighted inward ease supplies the affective quality of their occupation.
Calling or drawing by speech supplies active desire and available response.
Freedom from harm supplies the condition in which supported ease can remain open and alert.
An uttered word supplies an acoustic and relational event around the silent tableau.
Merciful tenderness identifies the source and tone of the peace addressed to them.
Paired counterparts keep the enjoyment socially organized rather than solitary.
Bodily support supplies stillness without canceling occupied delight or receptive attention.

structural_cues: The focus ayah is grammatically enclosed by 36:55, 36:57, and 36:58, which supply occupation, delight, desire, peace, and divine speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate active and acoustic framing; I infer that the reclining posture is receptive and engaged rather than vacant. Alternatively, شُغُل may denote an unspecified delight without requiring conversation or other outward activity.

changed_reading.before: Reclining is idle, private, and nearly mute.
changed_reading.after: Still bodies remain actively engrossed: paired enjoyment, callable desire, and reception of merciful peace coexist with repose.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus joins people to their azwaj; the next turn orders the criminals to sort themselves apart, and the following covenant distinguishes worshipful allegiance from the distant enemy. Togetherness in 36:56 is thus not undifferentiated gathering but a post-judgment affiliation among those fitted by relation or shared orientation.

activation_trace.role: Sorting a thing until it is distinct supplies the immediate opposite of the focus conjunction and pairing.
Cutting or severance sharpens the social consequence attached to the criminal designation.
A preserved covenant supplies the criterion by which affiliation is tested.
Submissive worship supplies the allegiance that can join a person to the wrong side.
Distance and severance supply the relational character of the prohibited allegiance.
Explicit enmity supplies the opposed social bond.
Companions sharing form, action, or condition supply the positive affiliation retained after sorting.

structural_cues: The joined tableau of 36:56 is followed almost immediately by the separation command of 36:59 and the allegiance test of 36:60-61.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conjunction, pairing, explicit sorting, and opposed allegiances; I infer that the focus companionship is one result of judgmental classification. Alternatively, أَزْوَٰجُهُمْ may remain strictly marital while the separation contrast operates only between larger groups.

changed_reading.before: Spouses are simply added to otherwise independent individuals.
changed_reading.after: Azwaj are also affiliates whose shared orientation survives sorting; togetherness itself is an outcome of judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late instruction opposes grief's inward roughness to what people conceal and reveal. The concealment root also carries side branches of hidden joy and a place of reclining, so the visible couch scene can be read as interior serenity finally given an external, protected form.

activation_trace.role: Roughness of the soul through grief supplies the inward texture reversed by ease.
Concealing something in the interior supplies the hidden side of the contrast.
Hidden joy and ease supply an affective interior that can later become manifest.
A place of settlement and reclining provides a lexical side bridge directly back to the focus furniture.
Making something visible supplies external manifestation after concealment.
The visible furnished couch gives hidden ease a concrete exterior.
Protective shade keeps manifested ease from becoming exposure.

structural_cues: 36:76 explicitly coordinates grief, speech, concealment, and manifestation, while its concealment inventory contains both hidden joy and a reclining place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward grief, concealment, manifestation, and lexical side branches of joy and repose; I infer an interior-to-exterior movement toward the focus tableau. Alternatively, the side branches may be associative rather than a deliberate causal link.

changed_reading.before: The ayah displays visible luxury without specifying an inward transformation.
changed_reading.after: The protected resting place externalizes serenity: concealed ease becomes inhabitable and visible without becoming vulnerable exposure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading uses the branch-distant wound-healing image within the root of ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ, so it must not replace the ordinary couch sense. It remains anchored because the same focus root supplies a wound becoming sound and still, while context supplies pain, protective forgiveness, and grief; downstream prose should present it only as a convalescent echo.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root ء ر ك at word 6, especially B005, supported by protective shade at word 4.

activation_trace.role: Pain and hurt supply the damaged condition from which convalescence differs.
Protective covering of fault supplies repair from harmful consequence.
A wound becoming sound and its swelling quieting supplies the convalescent core of the outlier.
Protective custody supplies the sheltered conditions of recovery.
The soul made rough by grief supplies a nonphysical wound whose texture can also be calmed.

changed_reading.before: The couches signify status and luxury.
changed_reading.after: They may also carry a contained echo of convalescence: bodily and inward wounds have settled under protective cover.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The focus noun still denotes shade; this outlier activates its branch of water remaining under trees and the couch root's arak-tree branch. Springs and drinking make the material analogy coherent, but downstream prose should describe a water-conserving microclimate as an echo, not claim that ظِلَٰلٍ literally means pools.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root ظ ل ل at word 4 through B008, reinforced by the tree branch B001 of ء ر ك at word 6.

activation_trace.role: Wide splitting and outflow supply moving water within the garden ecology.
A flowing water source supplies the hydrological input to the shaded refuge.
Water retained beneath trees and away from sun turns shade into a sustaining microclimate.
The arak-tree branch supplies vegetation within the material analogy while the surface retains the couch sense.
A place or instrument of drinking supplies human access to the retained water.

changed_reading.before: Shade is only the visual absence of direct sun.
changed_reading.after: Shade may also evoke a vegetated, water-retaining refuge that materially sustains the bodies at rest.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The closed-mouth branch of و ك ء is distant from the surface meaning reclining, so this is a contrastive acoustic echo, not a lexical gloss. It remains anchored in مُتَّكِـُٔونَ and gains context from the merciful word immediately after and punitive mouth-sealing later; downstream prose should qualify their quiet as possibly receptive rather than imposed.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root و ك ء at word 7 through B002, held against its ordinary reclining branch B004.

activation_trace.role: Peace free from harm supplies what the reclining group is available to receive.
An uttered word makes the quiet tableau acoustically receptive rather than empty.
Holding back and closing the mouth supplies the branch-distant possibility of quiet.
A preventing seal supplies the punitive form of imposed silence.
Opening the mouth in speech identifies the bodily channel that is sealed.
Meaningful speech transferred to the hands shows the consequence of the sealed mouth.

changed_reading.before: The reclining figures are silent because they are passive.
changed_reading.after: Their quiet may be unforced receptivity to a word of peace, sharply unlike the later mouths sealed while other limbs testify.

strongest_changes: Shade and bodily support become the preserving reversal of coercive collars, forced posture, and blinding cover.
The repeated pairing root and the later separation command widen azwaj from spouses alone toward fitted companions and post-judgment affiliation.
The resurrection sequence makes reclining wakeful rest after rushing, gathering, presence, and recompense rather than sleep or incapacity.
The immediate frame makes repose actively delightful and receptive, while the transport sequence makes it dependent on safe bearing and mercy.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context changed a static luxury tableau into a social and bodily topology: harmful holding becomes support, occluding cover becomes shelter, scattered movement becomes settled presence, and undifferentiated gathering becomes fitted companionship.
remaining_uncertainties: How far أَزْوَٰجُهُمْ should be widened beyond marital spouses to companions, kinds, or aligned cohorts.
Whether the vessel and hidden-interior branch analogies should shape final prose or remain diagnostic support only.
The convalescent, water-retaining, and receptive-silence readings are anchored but branch-distant and require explicit qualification.
